name: Genetic Identity Gate
description: Proves the system has a deterministic, reproducible genetic identity: canonical manifest, SHA-256, real Merkle root, System/Core/Agent/Runtime genomes, mission fingerprint, lineage and identity id - with no commit -> fingerprint circular dependency and no secret material.

checks.name: Mission fingerprint is well-formed and consistent
Manifest hash recomputes from canonical material
No secret material in the genome
checks.detail: 328 file(s) scanned against 13 secret rules; 0 unexplained finding(s); 3 finding(s) matched the reviewed allow-list (CI-local service credentials and one negative test fixture); 0 .env leaves; 0 certification/ leaves (both asserted to be 0, not assumed)

checks.name: Record is bound to the commit being certified
Agent capability surface is bound to real packages
checks.detail: 12/12 agent packages present, all exporting symbols, 2 capability evaluation file(s) bound

checks.name: Evidence artifacts are bound to the certified commit
checks.detail: all 31 evidence artifact(s) carry commit === d3903d5414a48dcfabb9e082efb4dd1ac242ee97

checks.name: Every workspace package is represented in the genome

checks.name: Zero-spend policy is bound into the genome

checks.name: Test suites are bound into the genome
